decisionsTitle: Race results, part 2: the public «Clasament» on the event page, a category filter and a bib search, the listing chip and the editor's «De făcut» row
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-17 (~08:20):** «Aș vrea să pot pune și clasament la final după cursă». Part 1 (the decision just before this one, `feat/race-results-v1`) built the data, the backoffice page, the rankings, the Administrator's publish tick and the one public read, `readPublicEventResults`; the event page drew nothing of it. This draws it. **Not in this decision, on purpose:** an email to each runner («Rezultatul tău»), result columns in the registrations Excel, and a timing provider that would fill the times itself — all deferred, to be decided by the owner.

**The section.** `ResultsSection` (`modules/results/ui/`), a Server Component drawn by `EventPageView` right after the start list, under `#clasament`, in the start list's outlined `<details>` shape but **open** on arrival (after a race the results are what a visitor came for). It draws **nothing at all** — no heading, no «în curând» — when the read answers `null`: not published, the privacy notice or the terms in force not describing the results, the race not started, the public list's period (§421) over, not a race; and nothing for a members' event (§552), in the editor's preview before saving (§579: a draft has no results, and the section reads the public cache), or while the database is away (`readOrWhileAway`, like the start list). A table from the small breakpoint up — «Loc», «Nr.», «Nume», «Timp» (the chip time in a caption under it when there is one), «Categorie» (the club's statistics' words, §787, `Admin.registrations.statistics`, and «loc N» in the category); at 320 pixels each row is a block of three lines (the checkpoints' stack, §757, tightened), the place at the left. The finishers come first in the sheet's order, then the runners who did not finish — «Abandon», «Neprezentat», «Descalificat» — **in the time column and without a place** (a dash for the eye, «Fără loc» for a screen reader); ties share a place, the page prints what the ranking gives. Under the heading one line says when it was published and until when it stays: «Publicat sâm., 23 nov. 2026, la 12:00 · rămâne pe pagină până dum., 20 dec. 2026, la 13:00», in the club's zone, with the house's date words (the period ends at an instant, so the line names the hour). The number's column is headed as the start list heads it above (“BIB”, one word for one thing on one page). The race number is written as the event writes it (§735, `pad3`): «007», and «Participant #007» — from the one `anonymousResultLabel(locale, bib, format)`, which the backoffice's «Pe site» line calls too.

**The name rule is the read's, unchanged** (§143, §396, §421, §743, and part 1's one more line: a registration made under a notice that described the results). The page adds **no name source and no condition of its own**: it asks `readPublicEventResults` through the public cache and prints `name`, or «Participant #număr» when it is null; a runner the club typed by hand is never named. The note at the foot says so in the start list's own quoted words: «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate», on a confirmed registration made after the notice began to describe the results. **Amends** §143 and §396: the public name rule reaches the results page, and the page is `data-nosnippet` like the list, so names stay out of search snippets (§421).

**Through the public cache, with the page's lifetime.** `cachedPublicEventResults` files the read under `places` and `events`, the tags part 1's save, its publish switch, a confirmation, a cancellation and an erasure already expire; it has **no saved copy** (a stale ranking is a wrong place, like a stale list). Its key carries the event, the club's period, the two notices' verdicts and the first results notice's version, so an approval reads a new entry. The clock is not in the key: the page is held until the race starts and until the period ends (`holdPageUntil`, `resultsClockInstants`), the cached rows are checked against the request's own `now` once more (a date passing is no write), and the listing is held the same way. One pure rule, `resultsOnShow`, is the cheap half the read applies — a race, published, started, inside the period, the notice and the terms describing it — so the page, the chip and the holds cannot disagree.

**The filter and the search** are the section's one client island, `ResultsFilter`: a chip per category present (native radios in the listing's chip shape, `FILTER_OPTION_SX`, §424, §789; «Toate» first; one category at a time, a runner is in one) and a numeric box «Caută după număr» (44 pixels, a glyph on every chip — the sex of the category, a group for «Toate» — passed by name across the boundary, and the whole row left out when scripts are off, since it would tick and narrow nothing; `inputMode="numeric"`, «contains»: 42 finds 42 and 142, «007» finds 7). It earns its place because narrowing as one types is what a server cannot do without a round trip, and the page is a cached static one (§549) with no address to carry a query. The table is drawn whole by the server and shows every row with no script; the island only sets `hidden` on a `<tr>` carrying `data-category` and `data-bib` and says «Niciun rând nu se potrivește.» as a status. The rule is `rowMatches`, pure and unit-tested.

**The listing's chip.** A finished race's card — on the listing, in the past events' fold, and the last race shown between seasons — wears a «Clasament» chip with the leaderboard glyph, a link to the page's `#clasament`. The rows carry one boolean (`events.results_published`, in `PUBLIC_COLUMNS`); the page reads the two cached notice/terms verdicts and «Termene» **once** (`eventsWithResultsChip`) and hands each card a boolean — never a query per card, and nothing at all for a page with no published race. The link is the 44-pixel box and the small chip sits inside it (`ResultsChip`: a `GlyphChip` with an `href` is a 24-pixel anchor, and every link on a card is held to 44 pixels in both directions). A series card never wears it: a series of dates is a run, and runs have no results. **The one boolean is “published and has at least one result row”** (`events.results_published AND EXISTS(event_results)` on `PUBLIC_COLUMNS`), so the chip, the holds and the section read the same fact and a chip never leads to a page that draws nothing. **A race whose start hour was never announced** (“Ora se anunță”) has no start for the public pages (§533), so it shows neither section nor chip, whatever the tick says.

**The editor's «De făcut».** `eventPageTodos` has no rows for an event that is over (§749); `results` and `resultsStart` are the exceptions: «Cursa s-a terminat și clasamentul nu e publicat.», **high**, for a race published on the site, not cancelled or archived, with its date announced, whose end has passed (a race saved without an end is over a day after it starts: the start is the meeting time, not the finish), whose results are not published and **while the public list's period lasts** (after it the page could not show them, so the row would nag for ever), **raised only for a colleague who may open the results page and while the notice and the terms in force describe `{{results}}`** (otherwise the row would promise a step they cannot take; `/admin/tasks` says what is missing). **`resultsStart`**, high, links to «Când și unde»: «Ora startului încă se anunță: clasamentul nu poate apărea pe pagină», for the same race when its day has passed but its hour was never announced, published or not — the row says why the page shows nothing rather than asking for a publication that would change nothing. Computed from the event on every read, never stored; its anchor is `page-results`, which the card turns into a link to `/admin/events/[id]/results` rather than a `#box-…` (the other rules' anchors are cards of the editor); the club's own typed lines are untouched.

**Refused.** A second query of names; a heading or a «curând» for an event with nothing to show; a URL for the filter (it would make the cached page a live twin for every tick); a toggle button for the chips; a 24-pixel link on a card; a chip on a series card; a chip per card that asks the database; a to-do row for every race that ever was. **Left open:** the email to each runner, the Excel columns, a timing provider. **A lane-51 rule for the dispatcher to decide:** `setResultsPublished` accepts the tick for a race whose hour was never announced and for a race with no row, and says «Clasamentul e acum public» over an empty page; refusing it there (or an info line on the results page like the one before the start) would close the gap this decision only explains.
changelogLine: - **«Clasament» on the race's page** — after the race, once an Administrator has published it, the results appear under the start list (place, number, name or «Participant #număr», time, category) with a filter by category and a search by race number; a finished race's card on the listing wears a «Clasament» chip; and the editor's «De făcut» lists «Cursa s-a terminat și clasamentul nu e publicat» (or says the start hour must be announced first). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race whose results are on show (published, started, the public list's period not over, the privacy notice and the terms in force describing them), when its event page is drawn, then «Clasament» appears under `#clasament` with a row per result in the sheet's order — the finishers by place, then those who did not finish with their word and no place, ties sharing a place — a name only where the public read gives one and «Participant #număr» (the number as the event writes it) everywhere else, the chip time under the time, the category in the club's words with the place in it, and the date it was published and the date it leaves; and when any of those conditions fails there is no heading and no sentence at all (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/public-section.test.ts`, e2e `race-results-public.spec.ts`.

Given a race's «Clasament» of more than one row, when a visitor ticks a category chip or types in «Caută după număr», then only the rows of that category whose number contains the digits typed stay on the page (a leading zero ignored), «Niciun rând nu se potrivește.» is said when none does, every row shows when the page has no script, and the filter carries no address (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/results-filter.test.ts`, integration `results/public-section.test.ts`, e2e `race-results-public.spec.ts`.

Given the events listing, when it is drawn, then the card of a race whose results are on show wears a «Clasament» chip linking to the event page's `#clasament`, a link 44 pixels tall, from one read of the notice's and the terms' verdicts for the whole page and the rows' own `results_published` (true only while the race has a result row), and no other card does — a race with no row, or whose start hour was never announced, wears none (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/results-open.test.ts`, integration `results/public-section.test.ts`.

Given a race published on the site whose end has passed, whose results are not published and whose public list's period is not over, when the event editor's «De făcut pentru pagina evenimentului» is computed, then it has one high row, «Cursa s-a terminat și clasamentul nu e publicat», linking to the results page; and, when its day has passed but its hour was never announced, one high row «Ora startului încă se anunță: clasamentul nu poate apărea pe pagină» linking to «Când și unde» (published or not); and none of the first for a viewer who may not open the results page or while the texts in force do not describe the results, none for a published result, a race still to run, a group run or any event that takes no results, a cancelled, archived or unpublished race, or one past its period (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `events/page-todos.test.ts`.
